name: Tsuwabuki Kirika
source:
Woman working on-site, who possesses toned body and enormous breasts; an elder sister-like beautiful woman.

Rough and muscle-headed, but still loved by her subordinates for her passionate and kind personality.

Due to such speech and strength, has never been sought by a man. Is a virgin with no romantic experience.

Secretly yearns to become a bride, has preferences for cute clothes like a maiden. A type who loves to do housework.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=954939]Getchu[/url]]
